sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    b = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pb=None
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='p': pb=n['boundary']
    rg=[n['boundary'] for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=8]
    return {'Rc':b[31][31],'Lc':b[34][16],'purple':pb,'greens':rg}
print('start', state())
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':31}])
print('after select right', state())
r=action(['UP'])
print('after UP', state(), 'changed', r['board_changed'])
r=action(['RIGHT'])
print('after RIGHT', state(), 'changed', r['board_changed'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
